exposure: A. Chohan Continuous Squeezing Suture (ACCSS) for controlling haemorrhage from the lower uterine segment at caesarean section
outcome: Duration of stay in the hospital
cohort: 47 patients with placenta praevia and accreta spectrum disorders
finding: ACCSS appears to be a simple, effective, and safe treatment option for placenta praevia and accreta spectrum disorders, as an alternative to hysterectomy.
